data.body: Anti-pattern scan complete: 1 confirmed candidate (the fixed file), 0 other occurrences. Scanned all rmdir-on-mkdir-lock sites (ticket-lib.sh:382, ticket-init.sh:241, deps.sh:294, cleanup-claude-session.sh:192). All others are SAFE: they are bare mutex locks (no file written into the lockdir, so rmdir-on-empty succeeds) or intentional remove-if-empty semantics. merge-to-main-pr.sh was the ONLY site writing a pid file INTO the lockdir while releasing with rmdir. No broader sweep needed. Fix verified GREEN: 26/26 suite pass, lockdir absent post-suite, shellcheck clean at CI bar (--severity=warning, exit 0); 6 pre-existing SC2004 style findings unrelated/out-of-scope.
